name: BEHAVIOR
description: BEHAVIOR is a benchmark for embodied AI featuring 100 everyday household activities in simulation, designed to test agents on realistic, diverse, and complex tasks such as cleaning, maintenance, and food preparation. It includes an object-centric predicate logic language for activity specification, simulator-agnostic environment features, and metrics for task progress and efficiency, supported by 500 human VR demonstrations.
reputation: Publicly available and designed to facilitate and calibrate embodied AI development; state-of-the-art methods struggle with its complexity
notes: Includes 500 human VR demonstrations as ground truth; designed to be simulator-agnostic
